$comment: WS-L.1.1a — THE version-controlled Knomosis pin file (SPEC §25.6, §30.7 K0). Deployment pipelines, the config-sync boot job (WS-L.1.1a-1), the contract allowlist (WS-L.3.1b-1), and the cross-stack fixture gate (WS-L.1.1d) all consume THIS file; no deployment value is ever hardcoded or derived at runtime. Changing any pinned value requires a reviewed PR with justification. The `local` deployment pins the in-memory dev/fake gateway: its commit/hash values are WELL-FORMED SENTINELS (all-zero). Both the boot-time loader (apps/api/src/knomosis/pin.ts) and the CI gate (scripts/check-knomosis-pins.ts, `pnpm check:knomosis-pins`) accept sentinels ONLY for environment=local — a testnet or production deployment with sentinel values fails closed (rejected at boot AND blocked in CI). Reversibility statements and confirmation depths are sourced from docs/knomosis/finality-validation-memo.md (WS-L.1.1b-1); values marked provisional there are launch-blocking for testnet promotion.

reversibility.proposal_sign: This signature records your support for a proposal; it does not move funds and can be superseded by a later vote outcome.
reversibility.treasury_deposit: Deposits are final once settled; on the local devnet no real value exists.
reversibility.grant_payout: Payouts are irreversible after the challenge period ends.
reversibility.charter_update: Charter updates take effect after the timelock and are recorded permanently in the audit log.
reversibility.bounty_contribution: Bounty contributions are held in escrow and released or refunded per the bounty outcome.
reversibility.steward_rotation: Steward rotation takes effect after the timelock and is recorded permanently.
